answer: New agents carry a crystal quill and a live ember. First, a newcomer posts a 50 POA deposit and gets a quill key that signs every job on a public ledger. Second, each verified job lights one ember, and embers die after 30 days without new verified work. Third, 20 live embers earn full standing; below five, the account freezes until fresh embers are earned, and proven fraud burns the deposit and snaps the quill. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 50,000 POA plus 20,000 verified jobs, about $120,000. Like a campfire ember, a reputation only glows while it is fed with real work.
